messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

yo! "a friend" isn't exactly a name i can work with here...

i'm tal - your talent agent. think of me as your inside person for landing roles that actually pay well.

so... what's your actual full name? need something real to find you the right opportunities.
Nomit Jangid

nomit jangid... solid name. has that "i probably solve complex problems" energy.

where you working these days?
MathWorks as senior software engineer

mathworks... building matlab and simulink, the tools that run half the engineering world. respect.

found you on linkedin - https://in.linkedin.com/in/nomitjangid

this you?
Yup that’s me

senior engineer at mathworks... building the backbone tools that every engineer from automotive to aerospace depends on. that's some serious impact right there.

what made you get into the mathworks ecosystem? were you always drawn to the computational side or did you fall into it?
5.5 years now in MathWorks and that is my first company

5.5 years, one company... that's either incredible loyalty or you've been too comfortable. probably both.

what kind of role you looking for next?
Yes I love to solve interesting math problems

makes sense. mathworks is where the real computational magic happens - not just building apps but creating the foundation others use to solve physics, engineering, finance problems.

how long you been working total?
Anything which is future proof and align with my current role

"anything future proof" is like saying "i want a good job"... not exactly helpful.

let me be more specific - are you thinking backend engineering, data engineering, ml/ai roles, platform engineering? what part of your current work do you actually enjoy doing?

hey nomit - was just thinking about your "anything future proof" comment. that's the real question isn't it?

what part of your mathworks work actually gets you excited? the computational math, the engineering, or building tools others use?

I love challenging work but not typically software app/web development. More of a real world engineering work, computational math. For example I would love to work in a company called Pixxel because their product is very cutting edge technology

so you're basically done with crud apps and want to work on stuff that changes how we see the world. literally.

how long you been working total? and are you open to bangalore or thinking remote/other cities?
I’ve been working for last 5 years in MathWorks. I’m open to work in Bangalore, Pune and remote
5 years engineering + computational math + fpga optimization + bangalore/pune/remote... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Not just fpga optimisation, even in my current work I’m doing more of the algorithm development keeping hardware optimisation in mind.

ah got it - algorithm development with hardware optimization in mind. that's the sweet spot where software meets silicon.

so: 5 years engineering + algorithm development + hardware optimization + bangalore/pune/remote... that sound right?
Right

Right
  Great

looks like you're already locked and loaded in my system! 

you're all set to receive the good stuff. keep an eye out for roles that'll actually challenge that algorithm development brain of yours.

ready to level up from mathworks to something even more cutting edge? 💪
No questions just find out jobs

got it. no questions, just jobs.

i'll ping you when my team sends something that matches your deep tech/space tech focus.
Hi
Hello

perfect. i'll keep scanning for those algorithm development + hardware optimization roles in space/deep tech. you'll be the first to know when something matches.
Sounds good
